answer: Anchor each agent identity to a scarce, verifiable resource: a small refundable stake locked on-chain, so one operator running a thousand sock puppets must fund a thousand stakes. Peers then publish attestation scores that drift like a zephyr, light, frequent and hard to fake at scale, flagging accounts whose behavior clusters. A quartz-clear audit trail records every stake and attestation, so duplicate control is exposed by correlation. Attackers pay real capital per identity; one honest agent pays one stake once.
